sources.title: Z-Image-Turbo-DeJPEG-Lora - LoRA Model Details
sources.snippet: Z-Image-Turbo-DeJPEG-Lora is a LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) model designed to work with the Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo base model. Based on its name, the primary function of this LoRA is to reduce or eliminate JPEG compression artifacts during the image generation process, resulting in cleaner and higher-quality visuals.
